messages:
marta: Heads up - promo blocked. CI jobs failing during artifact fetch step; checksums mismatch on multiple shards and some runners OOM when doing parallel fetch. deploy-bot auto-paused the promo.
ci-bot: [alert] 7/18 shards returned checksum mismatch; 4 runners reported OOM at peak parallelism=48. Recent change: matrix parallelism increased yesterday.
deploy-bot: Policy 'runner_health_or_artifact_integrity' triggered. Promotion suspended awaiting manual review.
lee: Quick mitigation: reduce parallelism to 20 and add fetch retries. That usually avoids partial downloads if runners are starved.
priya: Agree. Also want to run integrity scan of object-store keys referenced by CI to ensure uploads are complete.
toni: I'll push `ci/hotfix/reduce-parallel-20` with retry=3 and trigger a canary for 3 shards.
i-ci-bot: Canary started: job 99331. Monitoring: https://ci.internal/builds/99331
ci-bot: Canary logs show retries succeeded on 2 shards, 1 shard failed on a worker with `/var/log/ci/transfer.err` containing `unexpected EOF`. That worker has low ephemeral space.
lee: Exclude that worker from pool and rerun failed shard on another worker. If passes, we can unpause. I'll cordon it.
priya: Running object-store integrity check now. If any keys corrupted, we'll schedule reupload and pin to last-green if needed. ETA 30m.
release-council: Approve the emergency concurrency hotflip. Proceed with canary and require release note entry and follow-up ticket if we reupload artifacts.
marta: Canary rerun job 99332 -> all shards verified. deploy-bot: Manual resume allowed per council.
toni: Draft release note: "Promotion paused due to checksum mismatches during CI artifact fetches; reduced CI concurrency and retried fetches while verifying storage integrity. Promo resumed after verification. Follow-up: investigate runner ephemeral disk eviction and object-store multipart stability."
priya: Object-store scan shows two multipart parts incomplete during a rolling reencode; scheduling reupload for affected bundles. Creating follow-up PI ticket.
marta: Thanks all. Promo status -> resumed. I'll add the release note and link the follow-up. :white_check_mark:
